tool_args.rationale: The five pilot outputs are monotone-concave and consistent with the shared siphon subtree, but their s_grad values span only 0.018. As the supplied guidance notes, this leaves vmax and rho collinear. Acquire the lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe to obtain wider s_grad leverage before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit standard two-layer siphon sqrt-branch from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho collinear, so these rows do not identify the base-field parameters reliably.
A wide s_grad discriminating probe directly addresses the parameter ambiguity at lower cost.
It does not resolve the relevant parameter-identifiability issue and is explicitly unnecessary.
Observed s_grad values are near 1, well below the stated supercritical regime; that mechanism is not indicated.
